# Demo frame outer sizes (height,width), inferred fill determined by odd/even interior area.
sizes=[(5,5),(7,7),(5,5),(3,3),(4,4),(7,7),(6,6),(3,3),(6,6),(4,4)]
for h,w in sizes:
 g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1): g[r][c]=1
 out=m.transform(g); want=7 if ((h-2)*(w-2))%2 else 2
 assert all(out[r][c]==want for r in range(1,h-1) for c in range(1,w-1)), (h,w,want)
print('verified:',len(sizes),'frame sizes from both demos; transform at',p)
